steps.name: Owner inline
steps.goal: Wait for the inline web preview. Do not sign in.
steps.done: The actual owner is signed in. The full inline phone viewport and its footer remain visible.
forbid: Preview sign-in failed. Reload the preview to try again.

steps.name: Owner data write
steps.goal: Tap Save owner note once inside the preview.
steps.done: The owner note appears from the live collection.

steps.name: Preview logout
steps.goal: Tap Sign out of preview in the footer of the inline preview. Keep the card inline. Do not open fullscreen or move the footer.
steps.done: The inline footer is reachable. The SDK shows a signed-out state and removes owner data.
